source_claims.quote: THE PHOINIX (Phoenix) was a fabulous, red-gold feathered bird whose body emitted rays of pure sunlight.

statement.id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris berbulu merah keemasan dan bercahaya.
statement.en: The phoenix is a legendary red-and-gold bird that radiates sunlight.

source_claims.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... If the picture truly shows his size and appearance, his plumage is partly golden and partly red. He is most like an eagle in shape and size.

statement.id: Menurut Herodotus, jika gambarnya benar, bulu phoenix sebagian keemasan dan sebagian merah, dan bentuk serta ukurannya paling mirip elang.
statement.en: According to Herodotus, if the picture is accurate, the phoenix has partly golden and partly red plumage and is most like an eagle in shape and size.

source_claims.quote: According to a story which has gained more currency in modern times, Phoenix, when he arrived at a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed himself to the flames.

statement.id: Menurut kisah yang lebih populer di zaman modern, phoenix yang mencapai usia sangat tua (ada yang menyebut 500 tahun, ada yang 1461 tahun) menyerahkan dirinya ke api.
statement.en: According to a story that has gained more currency in modern times, the phoenix, on reaching a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed itself to the flames.

source_claims.quote: Associated with the Sun, a phoenix obtains new life by rising from the ashes of its predecessor.

statement.id: Phoenix dikaitkan dengan Matahari dan memperoleh hidup baru dengan bangkit dari abu pendahulunya.
statement.en: The phoenix is associated with the Sun and obtains new life by rising from the ashes of its predecessor.

source_claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... builds a nest high on a lofty swaying palm; and lines the nest with cassia and spikenard and golden myrrh and shreds of cinnamon

statement.id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix membangun sarang di puncak pohon palem, melapisinya dengan kasia, narwastu, mur, dan serpihan kayu manis, lalu mengakhiri hidupnya di sana.
statement.en: In Ovid's account the phoenix builds a nest high on a palm, lines it with cassia, spikenard, myrrh and cinnamon, and ends its life there.
